* 🔴 (13:30) User stated final guest count cutoff date for catering is September 1st, 2026.

* 🔴 (09:15) User stated final rehearsal dinner headcount must not exceed 40 people (updated Jul 23 to 35).

* 🟡 (08:30-21:10) Agent confirmed sunrise rates with Aperture Dream Studios, ordered leaf-based confetti samples, added emergency supplies checklist, messaged Apex Lighting, formatted place card templates, and checked classic car availability.

Date: Jul 19, 2026
* 🔴 (09:00) User stated final seating chart must group college friends at table four.
* 🔴 (12:45) User stated ring bearer pillow must be handmade from vintage lace.
* 🔴 (16:30) User stated welcome bags must include local craft beer and artisan chocolate.
* 🟢 (07:30, 10:40, 14:20, 18:45) User requested white rose/eucalyptus floral arches, acoustic indie cocktail playlist, black aprons for catering staff, and 45-minute sunset portraits.
* 🟡 (08:15-20:15) Agent updated floral brief for Bloom & Petal Co., mapped table four, compiled setlist, searched Etsy for lace pillows, emailed Gourmet Affair Catering, contacted City Brewery/Cocoa Bean Co. for bulk pricing, and adjusted evening timeline.

Date: Jul 23, 2026
* 🔴 (08:20) User specified morning getting-ready robes must be pure mulberry silk.
* 🔴 (09:15) User stated final rehearsal dinner headcount is strictly 35 guests at The Rustic Hearth Restaurant.
* 🔴 (13:10) User stated wedding favors must feature personalized ceramic coasters.
* 🔴 (16:45) User stated cake flavor is now pistachio (replacing lemon raspberry).
* 🔴 (17:00) User stated final payment for videographer is due on August 10, 2026.
* 🟢 (11:00, 15:00, 19:30) User asked for a midnight shuttle departure, pre-ceremony candid coffee coverage by photographer, and gluten-free macaron towers on the dessert table.
* 🟡 (08:20-18:15) Agent updated attire notes, finalized 35-guest reservation at The Rustic Hearth, added midnight shuttle run, ordered 100 custom ceramic coasters from Kiln & Clay Studio, added pre-ceremony candid coffee addendum with Shutterbug Memories, and set videographer payment calendar reminder.
  * ✅ Confirmed gluten-free macaron tower addition with Sweet Treats Bakery.
</observations>

</current-task>
